title: GASP Ossie Extension
description: Describes the GASP payloads in Apache Ossie documents. Every Ossie document GASP writes carries custom_extensions entries with vendor_name GASP whose data is a JSON string; this schema describes that string parsed as JSON, one definition per placement: the semantic model, a dataset, a metric and the mapping. GASP writes no extension on fields or relationships. Each key here is a gap in the Ossie specification today, so a key retired by an upstream merge leaves this schema. Versioned independently of the Ossie specification.

ModelExtension.description: On the semantic model document: how the model was made. profile_schema writes profiled; compile_model writes compiled and drops the profiled record it replaces.

profiled.description: The model was written by the schema profiler (profile_schema).

input.description: The schema format the profiler read: information_schema rows as JSON or CSV, a tables list or CREATE TABLE statements

questions.description: How many questions the profiler could not settle

compiled.description: The GASP metrics were compiled into the model (compile_model).

dialect.description: The dialect the compiled metrics and staged sources are written in

period_spine.description: The table of reporting periods the staged datasets read

metrics.description: How many GASP metrics were compiled in

staged.description: How many staged datasets were written

DatasetExtension.description: On a dataset. A reference dataset carries kind with cel and activeWhen where the ontology declares them; a staged dataset carries staged, for, reason and source_dialect; the period spine carries period_spine; a profiled dataset carries profile. record_decision adds profile to whatever a dataset already carries.

cel.description: The CEL event class the dataset holds

activeWhen.description: Grammar condition selecting live rows, used for cohort membership

staged.description: The dataset is a staged per-period dataset holding one metric's value

for.description: The metric the staged dataset holds

source_dialect.description: The dialect the dataset's source query is written in (Ossie's source has no dialect property)

sources.description: The source query in each other dialect

period_spine.description: The dataset is the table of reporting periods the staged datasets read

MetricExtension.description: On a metric GASP compiled: the canonical metric it implements.

form.description: The dual-lens form: Operating or Market

variant.description: The named variant of the formula

unit.description: The unit of the value; ratios are unscaled

formula.description: The canonical formula in the GASP grammar

gasp_breakdown.description: The breakdown dimension, as a field or dataset.field

staged.description: The metric reads a staged dataset

MappingExtension.description: On the mapping document. A mapping converted from a v1 adapter carries the adapter's metadata; propose_mapping writes organization and proposed; record_decision keeps what is there and adds metricOwners and decisions.

adapter_version.description: The version of the v1 adapter the mapping was converted from

metricOwners.description: Who owns each metric definition, as in the adapter schema

proposed.description: What the mapping proposer paired and what it left to review

datasets.description: Tables proposed to a GASP dataset

transforms.description: Field pairs read through a transform

decisions.description: Every decision on file, one per subject

OssieDialect.description: A registered Ossie dialect GASP compiles to

StagedReason.description: The construct the Ossie expression language cannot state, so the metric is staged

DatasetProfile.description: What the profiler inferred about the table, with confidence and evidence; record_decision marks a decided key, time field or kind declared

kind.description: The inferred or decided table kind

values.description: Column → the enum values listed for it

Question.description: What the profiler could not settle from the names and statistics

Candidate.description: A table or column pair the evidence supports without settling

UnmatchedTable.description: A table no GASP dataset matches, with the nearest one

DecisionRecord.description: A decision as recorded: who decided what, when, and what applying it did
